accountsOrRoles.name: deployer
accountsOrRoles.role: signs the deployment transaction with their own wallet

accountsOrRoles.name: initialOwner
accountsOrRoles.role: initial owner set by the constructor

steps: Set SEPOLIA_RPC_URL to an Ethereum Sepolia RPC endpoint.
Fund the deployer wallet with Sepolia ETH for gas.
Confirm the deployed contract address from the transaction receipt.
Call getHookPermissions() and verify beforeSwap is true and all other callbacks are false.
Confirm the hook address satisfies the declared beforeSwap permission before registering it in a pool key.
Confirm the PoolManager bound to the hook is 0xE03A1074c86CFeDd5C142C4F04F1a1536e203543.
